scope: Engineering foundations and isolated exact-record retrieval study, not full learned-policy results or architecture superiority

memory_probe.identity: Per-example random normalized continuous eight-dimensional identities, repeated across records and queries; no ID dictionary in learner
memory_probe.target: Most recent matching-identity exact public status record; conflict sequences and irrelevant identities. No noisy-record correctness claim.
memory_probe.model: Identical 3-layer pairwise learned content scorer, with/without nonnegative learned relative-time penalty. Temporal ordering is an explicit architectural prior, not discovered law.
memory_probe.optimizer: AdamW lr0.003 weight_decay0.0001 clip1; no tuning or test-driven recipe changes
memory_probe.objective: Cross entropy on public latest-record index; all fitted checkpoints and curves retained
memory_probe.budget: 2 CPU workers, torch1thread each, at most10 CPU minutes total fitting; stop and report incomplete if capped
memory_probe.selection: Final update only; ten fresh seeds; no best-seed promotion
memory_probe.analysis: Per-seed exact retrieval, stale same-identity selections, wrong-identity selections, status accuracy; paired seed difference and exact two-sided sign flip across4lengths with Holm correction. No inference from retrieval to world completion. No novelty claim against perfect latest-record reference.

sparse_engineering.semantics: Copy-on-write state; skip address and encoder calls on closed gates; update only chosen rows/slots for admitted records. Every observation still pays admission cost.
sparse_engineering.comparators: Same trained/fixed weights, dense reference versus sparse inference; require exact admission/address/state and action logits on fixed probe streams
sparse_engineering.measurements: CPU latency distributions, throughput, torch allocator bytes and actual processed row counts. Try hardware counters; mark unavailable if permission denied. Allocator/counter estimates are not measured DRAM traffic. No guaranteed speedup.

uncertainty_benchmark.status: Implement and verify worlds/references; no learned-agent fitting authorized by this foundations protocol
uncertainty_benchmark.public_relations: Known acyclic pair or independent entities; no hidden relation information supplied to student
uncertainty_benchmark.receipts: Inspection exact/provenance tagged; repair emits one noisy status for EACH entity regardless of hidden change. Payload length/identity cannot leak which hidden state changed.
uncertainty_benchmark.references: Exact4-state public Bayes filter with known-law depth2 receding-horizon expected-cost controller; private safe-progress teacher. Planner is bounded, not globally optimal.
uncertainty_benchmark.metrics: Completion, physical repair, faults, premature/missing stop, inspections, actions, cost split, public-belief Brier, disagreement with public latest-record shortcut
uncertainty_benchmark.information_gap: Private/public gap includes bounded planner approximation; no claim it is pure unavoidable information regret
uncertainty_benchmark.acceptance: Probability normalization and independent enumeration; sensor likelihood/exact inspection fixtures; identical-public-history different-hidden-state fixture; planner sometimes acquires costly information; reference outcomes preserved regardless of failure

claim_gates: Ten seeds alone do not establish convergence. Perfect public reference blocks strict-completion superiority on exact-record task. No full-agent upgrade, original CDL, general symbolic CASM, JEPA benefit, C5, commercial safety or physical-traffic saving claim from foundations. Freeze a separate full-policy training protocol after these engineering checks, without tuning on these test outcomes.
